description: Deterministic ship runner: the sidecar drives the ship phase as a TS state machine (verify-PRD -> gates -> bump -> finalize -> push -> PR-create -> merge-mode), with the PR body templated from the PRD (LLM removed from the ship path)

officialDocsConsulted.summary: Confirmed --title, --body-file (-F) and --base (-B) are current flags with no deprecations; --body-file reads the PR body from a file, which the runner uses via a temp file.

Confirmed --auto (merge after requirements are met) and --squash are current flags with no deprecations. Behavior when the repo disallows auto-merge is not documented, so the runner treats gh pr merge failure as best-effort (hint + continue), matching the existing cam-ship.md contract.

userStories.title: Implement the deterministic pre-PR ship sequence (runShipPhase)
userStories.description: As the sidecar, I need a dep-injected TS state machine that runs verify-PRD-complete, commits-ahead check, quality gates, version bump, cycle-close finalize, and branch push deterministically so that no LLM interprets cam-ship.md steps 1-6 (same logic-in-markdown scar as CAM-49/72/86/104).
acceptanceCriteria: src/supervisor/ship-runner.ts exports runShipPhase(opts) returning a discriminated ShipPhaseResult with at least these kinds: on-main, prd-incomplete (carrying the blocking story ids), no-commits-ahead, gates-failed (carrying the failing output tail), bump-failed, finalize-failed, push-failed, ready-for-pr. [oracle: grep -q 'ready-for-pr' src/supervisor/ship-runner.ts]

Step order is enforced and fail-fast: branch guard (refuse when the current branch is main), PRD-complete check (every story with requires != 'operator' has passes true), commits-ahead-of-main check (git log main..HEAD non-empty), quality gates via injected runGatesFn (production default command: bun run check:all), bump via injected bumpFn (wrapping runShipBump), finalize via injected finalizeFn (wrapping finalizeCycleClose), then git push origin <branch>. A failed step returns its result kind without executing any later step. [oracle: bun test test/ship-runner.test.ts]

The PRD snapshot (project, description, issueNumber, stories) is captured in memory BEFORE finalizeFn runs and is carried inside the ready-for-pr result, because finalize git-rms prd.json. [oracle: bun test test/ship-runner.test.ts]

All side effects are injected (spawnFn, readPrd, runGatesFn, bumpFn, finalizeFn, clock, optional logEvent); every git spawn guards its exit status explicitly (spawnSync does not throw on non-zero exit). [oracle: bun test test/ship-runner.test.ts]

A gates-failed result never mutates ratchet budget files: the runner contains no writes to scripts/file-size-budget.json or scripts/coverage-budget.json (ratchet raises are escalation, never auto-fix). [oracle: file-assert ! grep -q 'file-size-budget' src/supervisor/ship-runner.ts]

The push step never force-pushes and never targets main: the git argv is exactly push origin <current-branch> with no --force variant anywhere in the module. [oracle: file-assert ! grep -q 'force' src/supervisor/ship-runner.ts]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
Full gate spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Files: src/supervisor/ship-runner.ts (new), test/ship-runner.test.ts (new). Mirror src/supervisor/plan-runner.ts conventions exactly: dep-injected options interface, discriminated result union, helpers extracted for biome cognitive-complexity limits (patterns.md 'factory/helper extraction'). Unlike the plan runner, NO worker pane is spawned (zero LLM in this phase), so no pane mutex, no uuid, no respawn-pane. Reuse SpawnFn from loop.ts. runShipBump (src/release/ship-bump.ts) and finalizeCycleClose (src/commands/ship-finalize.ts) already exist as injectable functions; wrap them behind bumpFn/finalizeFn seams so unit tests never touch real git. Gotcha: bump then finalize then push is the cam-ship.md order; bump is NOT idempotent (re-run would double-bump), so a mid-sequence failure escalates to the operator (recovery per docs/recovery-runbook.md), never auto-resumes. finalizeCycleClose is idempotent (noOp when prd.json absent). Do not add a config knob for the gates command in this story; injected default 'bun run check:all' with a cam-init adaptation note deferred.

userStories.title: Implement the PR-create and merge-mode step (gh integration)
userStories.description: As the ship runner, I need a deterministic PR-create step (gh pr create, auto-merge, artifact comment, merge-mode branching) so that the last LLM-orchestrated part of ship becomes TS code with the templated PR body from US-001.
acceptanceCriteria: src/release/ship-pr.ts exports runShipPrStep(opts): writes the composePrBody output to a temp body file, creates the PR via gh pr create --title <composePrTitle output> --body-file <tmpfile> --base main, then enables auto-merge via gh pr merge --auto --squash as best-effort (a merge failure emits the settings hint and does not abort; the PR is already created). [oracle: bun test test/release/ship-pr.test.ts]

gh mutation calls (pr create, pr merge, pr comment, issue close) run with GITHUB_TOKEN stripped from the child env, mirroring the update-branch env-strip pattern in sidecar.ts (keyring OAuth fallback); read-only gh calls keep the ambient env. [oracle: grep -q 'GITHUB_TOKEN' src/release/ship-pr.ts]

When scripts/cam/review-artifact.txt exists, its content is posted as a PR comment prefixed with the artifact-of-record heading (best-effort: missing file or gh failure never aborts the ship). [oracle: bun test test/release/ship-pr.test.ts]

Merge-mode branching reads readMergeMode: ci-gated enriches .claude/.cam-merge-watch.json with prNumber and mergedBranch via readMergeWatchState/writeMergeWatchState (read-modify-write preserving the issueId stashed by finalize; never a blind overwrite; exactly one write, before the sidecar consumes the file); immediate closes the issue per backend (none: closeIssueOnMain with the stashed issueId then remove the watch file; github: gh issue close best-effort; linear: notify line telling the operator to close manually). [oracle: bun test test/release/ship-pr.test.ts]

runShipPhase (ship-runner.ts) invokes runShipPrStep after ready-for-pr and surfaces the outcome in the ShipPhaseResult union: a shipped kind carrying prNumber and mergeMode, and a pr-create-failed kind. [oracle: bun test test/ship-runner.test.ts]

Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]

userStories.notes: Files: src/release/ship-pr.ts (new), test/release/ship-pr.test.ts (new), src/supervisor/ship-runner.ts (edit: wire the step). Reuse existing helpers: readMergeMode (src/config/models.ts), readMergeWatchState/writeMergeWatchState/MERGE_WATCH_FILENAME (src/release/merge-watch.ts), closeIssueOnMain (src/commands/issue-specify.ts), REVIEW_ARTIFACT_FILENAME (src/supervisor/review-report.ts). Gotchas: (a) merge-watch consume-on-read is by-design; the sidecar deletes the file when it starts watching, so the runner must never re-write it after the enrichment write (double post-merge). (b) GITHUB_TOKEN strip: see sidecar.ts makeProductionUpdateBranchFn (env copy omitting GITHUB_TOKEN) and memory ship-pr-create-token-keyring-fallback. (c) The PR number comes from gh pr view --json number --jq .number or from the create output; parse deterministically, guard NaN. (d) All gh spawns via injected SpawnFn shape so tests assert exact argv without a real gh.

userStories.title: Wire the shipping phase into the sidecar loop and make the CLEAN trigger deterministic
userStories.description: As the sidecar, I need a phase:shipping branch in runSidecarLoop plus production wiring so that the CLEAN verdict flows into the deterministic ship runner instead of injecting /cam-ship into the orchestrator pane.
acceptanceCriteria: runSidecarLoop (src/supervisor/loop.ts) handles phase 'shipping': an optional runShipPhaseFn dep is invoked on a shipping tick, guarded by an outer try/catch that logs a sidecar-exit event on crash; the branch precedes the active check because phase shipping derives active false (mirrors the planning branch). [oracle: grep -q "loopPhase === 'shipping'" src/supervisor/loop.ts]

sidecar.ts provides makeProductionShipPhaseFn wiring runShipPhase with production adapters (spawnSync-backed spawnFn, bun run check:all gates adapter, runShipBump/finalizeCycleClose adapters shared with the index.ts --bump/--finalize wiring, readMergeMode, merge-watch helpers, closeIssueOnMain) and ALWAYS resets phase to idle when the run ends (finally), success or failure. [oracle: bun test test/sidecar-ship-phase.test.ts]

Failure result kinds (on-main, prd-incomplete, no-commits-ahead, gates-failed, bump-failed, finalize-failed, push-failed, pr-create-failed) push a one-line summary to the orchestrator pane via the notifyOrchestrator seam and fire escalateFn best-effort (fire-and-forget); the shipped kind pushes a success line with PR number and merge mode. [oracle: bun test test/sidecar-ship-phase.test.ts]

The auto-mode CLEAN trigger is deterministic: the production autoShipFn calls setPhase('shipping') instead of tmux send-keys /cam-ship (no send-keys dispatch of /cam-ship remains in sidecar.ts); the fire-once autoShipDispatchedAt marker gate in loop.ts is unchanged. [oracle: file-assert ! grep -q "'/cam-ship'" src/commands/sidecar.ts]

Structured events are logged for the ship-phase outcome (kind and result detail) via the existing worker event log, so a failed ship is diagnosable from .claude/cam-worker-events.jsonl without reading source. [oracle: bun test test/sidecar-ship-phase.test.ts]
